name: Spare the Dying

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Living creature at 0 HP becomes Stable; 15-foot base range doubles at character levels 5/11/17; no additional spell healing or invented revival.

rules.text: Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn’t dead.
The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).
